purpose: Qualify only the numerical fixed-point representation of the published dry-bin Green-Ampt initialization rule and its cache provenance implications.

source_contract.published_stop_rule: iterate assumed Z_de against Green-Ampt-derived Z_d until absolute depth difference is less than 0.0005 cm
source_contract.green_ampt_form: F = K*dt + A*ln(1 + F/A), with A = psi*delta_theta and Z = F/delta_theta
source_contract.2015_role: new dry-bin initial advance is bounded by the maximum advance during the timestep described by Talbot and Ogden 2008

hard_nonclaims: No claim that the selected generic K, psi and delta-theta tuples reproduce M2WC70 bin mapping.
No claim of M2WC70 code equivalence.
No rainfall allocation, partial dry-bin funding, capillary relaxation or production runtime qualification.
No Green-Ampt dry-bin value may be promoted to a material-only immutable parameter.
failure_policy: Preserve any failure. Do not loosen the 0.0005 cm published iteration criterion after execution.
